title: Monotonicity of computation time
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state deterministic oracle Turing machine, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $x,y$ be words over its alphabet. If $M$ on input $x$ with oracle $O$ halts with output $y$ after $t$ steps, then it does so after every $t'\ge t$ steps.
